Module H: Takeaway
The Proxy pattern provides a
substitute or placeholder
for another object
It controls access and adds behavior
without modifying
the original service
There are many types:
virtual, protection, remote, logging, caching, smart
reference
It follows the
Open/Closed Principle
by allowing new proxies without changing
existing code
It is similar to Decorator in structure but different in
intent and lifecycle
management
